ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creates UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Ley 599 de 2000, Código Penal, Art. 323 (money laundering offense); Ley 2155 de 2021, Art. 27, and DIAN Resolución 000164 de 2021 (mandatory Beneficiario Final registry); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 100-000005 de 2017, as amended by Circular Externa 100-000003 de 2021 (SAGRILAFT self-control system); Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS statute); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971). The Colombian UBO register filing requires identifying any natural person with a direct or indirect participation of 5% or more, or with control authority, filed annually with DIAN.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Cámara de Comercio competente for the registered domicile

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Documento Privado de Constitución de la S.A.S. (Private Incorporation Instrument Under Ley 1258 de 2008, Art. 5)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders or licensed Colombian attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Registration with the Cámara de Comercio; notarized public deed required only if real property is contributed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Incorporation Extract of Each Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or notary in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Apostille Convention states) OR Consular Legalization at a Colombian embassy (non-Apostille states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Poder Especial (Power of Attorney) Appointing the Local Incorporation Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders or UBOs executing abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization plus notarized Spanish translation if executed outside Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or National Identity Document of Each UBO and Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority of the document holder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization with certified Spanish translation for non-Spanish documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all founders, UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombia's national PEP databases maintained by the UIAF and Procuraduría General, and Interpol Red Notices. Under SAGRILAFT (Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 100-000005 de 2017, as amended), the S.A.S. must apply enhanced due diligence to any PEP-linked investor and implement transaction monitoring calibrated to its e-commerce payment rails (Klarna BNPL and Shopify Payments), classifying the activity as Low_Risk_Standard with mandatory periodic risk reassessment.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Sociedades (RUES) at www.rues.org.co, operated through the competent territorial Cámara de Comercio, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá at www.ccb.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish or in a Latin-alphabet transliteration that permits clear reading; foreign-language or fantasy terms are accepted if distinctive and not misleading, and the name must end with the mandatory suffix 'S.A.S.' (Ley 1258 de 2008, Art. 12). The name must not create identity or similarity with an existing registered company per the homonimia doctrine applied by the Cámara de Comercio and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Corporación Financiera / Aseguradora (prior Superintendencia Financiera authorization required)
Nacional / Presidencia / Ministerio / Central (prior ministerial authorization required)
S.A. / Ltda. / Limitada / S.C.A. (conflicting corporate-type suffixes)
Fondo de Pensiones / Fondo de Inversión / Bolsa (regulated financial terms)
Minería / Hidrocarburos / Energía (sector-specific state authorization required)
Names identical to an existing registered company (prohibited by homonimia)
Names contrary to public order or good customs (Código de Comercio, Art. 651)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a denial issued by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant may file a reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) with the same chamber within 10 business days of the denial date, per Ley 1437 de 2011, Arts. 74-76. The chamber must decide within 15 business days. If denied on reconsideration, the applicant may file a subsidiary appeal (recurso de apelación) with the Delegatura de Asuntos Jurisdiccionales of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, which must resolve the appeal within 10 business days. The petition must annex the original homonimia certificate, the precise denied name, and a controlled list of alternative names for expedited substitution.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for an online fast-fashion S.A.S. only if a physical, real address within the selected Colombian municipality is declared as the statutory domicile for service of process; a coworking or shared-office virtual address is acceptable, but a mere P.O. Box is not. The Cámara de Comercio registration must reflect a verifiable physical location, and the address must appear consistently in the RUES, RUT, and e-commerce terms of service.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated under 5% annual probability) for a registered low-risk, license-free e-commerce merchant; unannounced on-site verification is most likely during DIAN tax audits, VAT registration validation, or consumer complaints under Ley 1480 de 2011.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Régimen de las Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), arts. 1, 4, 5, 17, 19, 22 and 27; Código de Comercio, arts. 98-124 and 354-360; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES regime); Ley 1429 de 2010 (business formalization incentives).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) at www.rues.org.co.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument), signed by all founders and filed in duplicate with the Mercantile Registry; a public deed (Escritura Pública) is substituted only when real estate is contributed to the capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None: Ley 1258 de 2008 imposes no minimum or maximum capital and no escrow or deposit rule. Capital is freely fixed in the by-laws; payment terms of subscribed shares may be deferred therein, and unpaid balances are enforceable shareholder obligations. Contributions in kind require a notarized contribution deed recorded with the registry application.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S.
On [date], the initial board of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., constituted under Ley 1258 de 2008, resolves:
1. To ratify the subscription of [number] ordinary shares, fully subscribed and paid-in, equal to 100% of the capital in the constitutive Documento Privado.
2. To adopt the registered office at [address], [city], Colombia, authorizing lease and furnishing contracts.
3. To appoint [name], ID [number], as Legal Representative and General Manager, with full powers under the bylaws.
4. To authorize the Legal Representative to secure DIAN tax registration, open corporate bank accounts, and register corporate books at the Cámara de Comercio.
Ratified unanimously.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - official portal https://www.dian.gov.co; MUISCA transactional registration portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must obtain a local NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) before commencing operations by appointing a legal representative in Colombia, registering the S.A.S. with the Chamber of Commerce under RUES, and submitting the DIAN registration form/RUES data; the NIT certificate is issued electronically via MUISCA after DIAN validation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or transparent-entity election exists; Colombian tax law applies mandatory entity-level taxation to S.A.S. A qualified small S.A.S. may elect the optional Régimen Simple de Tributación (single consolidated tax) if below the statutory threshold; otherwise, no hybrid-mismatch or flow-through election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 - no fixed turnover threshold for S.A.S. corporate e-retailers; VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable retail sale of goods in Colombia. Natural-person microbusinesses enjoy a limited exception under 3,500 UVT, but SAS online apparel retailers are not eligible for that exception.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory DIAN e-invoicing (Facturación Electrónica): all S.A.S. sellers with tax residency must issue electronic XML invoices through DIAN's SEE service using an authorized technology provider (or DIAN free system) with cryptographic signature, QR code and CUFE/CUDS digital stamp. Invoices and export declarations are cleared in near real-time via MUISCA/DIAN APIs before use.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of fast-fashion goods are zero-rated (excluded from VAT) when: (i) goods physically leave Colombian customs territory; (ii) the sale is concluded by a Colombian S.A.S. and the buyer is abroad; (iii) the export is documented with a valid Declaración de Exportación (DEX); and (iv) the corresponding foreign exchange proceeds are properly repatriated through the Colombian exchange market. Offshore services must additionally satisfy the 'export of services' tests in Articles 481 and 484 of the ET.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) - export customs declaration
Transport document (Bill of Lading for ocean freight or Air Waybill for air freight)
Certificate of exchange settlement / Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Liquidación de Divisas)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may reconstruct and audit exports retroactively; failure to substantiate VAT zero-rating results in the VAT difference charged to the exporter plus daily default interest, a 20% penalty on the improperly claimed refund under Article 676 ET, customs penalties for non-build-up of export formalities (Decree 1165/2019, up to 150% of goods value), and criminal liability for fraudulent export declarations/invoice misuse under Law 1762/2015.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia). Foreign-exchange policy is set by the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República and implemented under Law 9 of 1991, Law 31 of 1992, Decreto Único Reglamentario 1068 de 2015 (Book 2, Title 17), Resolución Externa 8 de 2000 (as amended by Resolución Externa 1 de 2018) and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. The Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises licensed exchange intermediaries (IMCs), while the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) enforces customs, exchange sanctions and foreign-trade declaration requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime for the COP. Current-account transactions (trade in goods and services) are freely convertible without prior central-bank approval, but all in-scope proceeds and payments must be routed through the Mercado Cambiario via an authorized IMC. Capital-account operations (foreign direct investment, external credit, portfolio investment) are likewise permitted without exchange licensing, but are subject to mandatory registration with the Banco de la República and mandatory channeling through an IMC. Profit remittance and capital repatriation for registered FDI are executable without further exchange authorization, subject to: (i) the non-resident investor keeping the investment duly registered in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales; and (ii) the dividend payment being documented in the statutory financial statements and satisfying DIAN tax obligations. For an e-commerce retailer, the practical hurdles are documentary rather than regulatory: proving the underlying trade through electronic export declarations, e-invoices and PSP settlement statements in order to demonstrate the legitimate origin of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory channeling obligation: 100% of each goods-export value must enter the Colombian foreign-exchange market within six (6) months from the date of the export declaration/shipment; services export proceeds carry the same six-month window counted from accrual or billing. There is no mandatory minimum conversion ratio into COP: the exporter may (i) sell the foreign currency to an IMC at the market rate, (ii) credit it to a foreign-currency deposit account held in a Colombian bank, or (iii) transfer it to a pre-registered cuenta de compensación abroad. For e-commerce exporters, the channeling event is perfected only when the PSP settlement (Shopify Payments, Klarna) reaches the IMC account and the IMC files the corresponding Declaración de Cambio; receipt through an unlicensed offshore EMI or personal account breaks the chain and constitutes an exchange infraction. Non-channeling within six months triggers the exchange-control penalty regime (up to 200% of the unrepatriated value plus default interest) and may also raise SARLAFT suspicion under DIAN/SFC cross-matching.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP current account) plus USD foreign-currency sub-account for FX channeling
Operational Account (COP) / Capital Escrow Account for FDI tracking
Operational Account (COP) / Merchant settlement account for PSP payouts
Operational Account (COP) / FX hedging margin and collateral account
Operational Account (COP / USD) with international cross-border clearing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementario)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 10 March and 23 April following the fiscal year-end; exact date assigned by DIAN based on the last two digits of the taxpayer NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% per month of unpaid tax, default interest, and penalties up to 20% of the assessed tax; continued non-filing triggers compulsory collections, asset seizure, and tax liability liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local chamber of commerce where registered office is located)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal imposes a fine based on company assets, plus a monthly surcharge; after 90 days of non-renewal the registry is suspended and after recurrent non-renewal the commercial registration may be administratively cancelled.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the date published by DIAN, generally between 1 March and 15 April for owner, counterparty, and transaction data of the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or filing with errors may result in fines of up to 5,000 UVT and penalties equivalent to 0.5% of the information values requested; repeated omission can lead to administrative tax sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statement approval and deposit with the Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio and shareholders’ assembly (internal corporate act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved at the ordinary shareholders’ meeting by 31 March; approved statements are deposited with the Chamber within the term established by commercial law, usually before May 31.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve and file financial statements may block registry renewal, prevent lawful distributions, and expose the legal representative to corporate fines and possible judicial involuntary dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for an S.A.S. when at the end of the fiscal year total assets or gross income exceed 5,000 monthly minimum legal wages (SMLMV). Companies below this threshold may still require an independent accountant’s review when mandated by the articles of incorporation or requested by shareholders representing at least 10% of the outstanding shares.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared under Colombian accounting standards implementing IFRS: full NIIF (IFRS) for large entities or NIIF para las PYMES (IFRS for SMEs) for smaller companies, in accordance with Law 1314 of 2009 and DIAN regulations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must file and maintain ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) data in DIAN's RUBF platform. Any direct or indirect ownership change must be updated within 30 calendar days of the transaction. At each annual commercial registry renewal, the company must confirm that its shareholder register and UBO declarations are consistent; if no change has occurred, the previous RUBF record remains valid and serves as the annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minutes book of shareholders' assemblies (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Minutes book of board of directors, if any (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Register of legal representatives and deputies (Registro de Representantes Legales)
RUBF register of final beneficial owners
